_real_world.class: Type 346A (4-face fixed AESA), the primary volume-search radar on Type 052D
public_equipment: Type 517B (052D) or Type 518 L-band (052DL) air-search radar

_provenance.modeling_note: Primary S-band AESA for Type 052D/052DL, about 40% smaller aperture than Type 346B on Type 055 (per the OOB's Type 055 entry, which states the reverse ratio). No A/B detection-range figure exists for either radar; the ~400 km forum estimate for Type 346A anchors this record's max_range, kept below the Type 346B module's value for internal consistency with the stated aperture difference.

sensor.type.note: Type 346A is an AESA radar; Radar is the matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: no A/B detection-range figure; forum estimate ~400 km for Type 346A, used directly, kept below the Type 346B module (480 km) for consistency with the OOB's stated ~40% aperture difference

sensor.fov_deg.note: 4-face fixed array gives full 360-deg coverage; engine models one merged radar, not per-face FOV

sensor.scan_period.note: no public scan-rate figure; engineering estimate consistent with a 4-face AESA volume-search radar, matching the Type 346B module's pattern

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; engineering estimate slightly below the Type 346B module given the smaller aperture

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a fixed-face AESA, slightly worse than the larger Type 346B array

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a fixed-face AESA, slightly worse than the larger Type 346B array

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; engineering estimate consistent with a fleet air-defence radar

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, consistent with this packet's simplified surface-search detection model

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other large naval AESA modules

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce max_range at a reference target; no public figure

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention used across this packet's naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public mast height for Type 052D; engineering estimate typical of a ~157m destroyer's integrated mast, lower than the Type 055's larger mast

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval AESA modules (horizon-geometry bias term)

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne air/surface search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with this packet's simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled consistent with the packet's convention for a long-range search radar

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval AESA modules

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval AESA modules

modeling_notes: 052DL's Type 518 L-band aft radar (vs 052D's Type 517B) is not separately modeled as a second sensor record; Naval News only confirms 'a different aft radar' without characterizing it, and the L-band attribution is C-only (Wikipedia/globalmilitary). One merged sensor_ref is used for both variants, consistent with writing 052D/052DL as a single ship record per the task's naming.
